      How to use it

      1. Pick a colour and a tool, then draw on the canvas.
      2. Add layers to keep parts apart, and frames to animate.
      3. Turn on onion skin to see the last frame while you draw.
      4. Export a PNG, a sprite sheet + JSON, or a GIF.
